cards.title: Create Table
Insert Row
cards.code:
INSERT INTO users (name, email)
VALUES ('Luis', 'luis@example.com');

cards.title: Select All
cards.code: SELECT * FROM users;

cards.title: Select Specific Columns
cards.code: SELECT name, email FROM users;

cards.title: Order & Limit
WHERE Clause
cards.code: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1;

cards.title: Multiple Conditions
cards.code:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE age > 18 AND status = 'active';

cards.title: LIKE & IN
cards.code:
SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'L%';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);

cards.title: Inner Join
Left Join
cards.description: Returns all users, even those with no matching orders.

cards.title: COUNT, SUM, AVG
cards.code:
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(total), AVG(total)
FROM orders;

cards.title: GROUP BY
HAVING
cards.code:
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

cards.title: Update Row
Delete Row
cards.code: DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1;

cards.title: Alter Table
cards.code: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN age INT;

cards.title: Drop Table
cards.code: DROP TABLE users;

cards.title: Index
cards.code: CREATE INDEX idx_email ON users(email);
cards.description: Speeds up lookups on the email column.

cards.title: Subquery in WHERE
cards.code:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total > 100);
